skill.rampage.description: Bounces very fast from edge to edge, knocking aside everyone in the way, then returns to the middle.
skill.shockwave.description: A blast that hurls the five nearest fighters across the arena and pushes back and slows the rest.
skill.leap.description: Jumps onto the thickest group of fighters and damages everyone where it lands.
skill.vortex.description: Several whirlwinds each catch a handful of fighters, spin them and carry them off for a few seconds.
skill.smite.description: Lightning strikes the three chatters who dealt the most damage and leaves burning ground.
skill.shield.description: Cannot be hurt for a few seconds.
skill.minions.description: Summons small copies of itself that fight on its side.
skill.enrage.description: Below 30% health it grows, moves faster and hits harder. Always active, not cast.

overlay.feed.firstBlood.2: {victim} is first to go. {killer} says thanks for the warm-up
overlay.feed.firstBlood.3: First blood goes to {killer}. {victim} will be remembered. Briefly.
overlay.feed.streak.1: {killer} ends {victim}'s streak. It was nice while it lasted
overlay.feed.streak.2: {victim} was on a roll. Then {killer} happened.
overlay.feed.streak.3: {killer} humbles {victim}, who was getting a bit too confident
overlay.feed.spree.1: {killer} is on a spree: {victim} is the latest
overlay.feed.crown.1: The crown falls! {killer} knocks it off {victim}
overlay.feed.crown.2: Heavy is the head: {victim} loses the crown to {killer}
overlay.feed.last.1: {victim} held out last for their guild. {killer} turns off the lights
overlay.feed.last.2: {killer} finishes {victim}, the last one standing. Standing no more.
overlay.feed.last.3: And then there were none: {killer} takes out {victim}
overlay.feed.godFalls.1: {victim} has fallen! {killer} lands the final blow
overlay.feed.godFalls.2: {killer} just slew {victim}. Chat will never let this go
overlay.feed.godFalls.3: Down goes {victim}! {killer} gets bragging rights for life
overlay.feed.strike.4: {victim} has left the chat, courtesy of {killer}
overlay.feed.arrow.2: {victim} took an arrow to the everything. Thanks, {killer}
overlay.feed.blast.1: {killer}'s blast circle had {victim}'s name on it
overlay.feed.blast.2: {victim} stood in the glowing circle. {killer} sends regards
overlay.feed.rampage.2: {killer} runs {victim} over and doesn't even slow down
overlay.feed.shockwave.2: {victim} rode {killer}'s Shockwave all the way out
overlay.feed.leap.2: {victim} looked up too late. {killer} dropped in
overlay.feed.fire.1: {victim} stood in {killer}'s fire. Don't stand in the fire.
overlay.feed.barrel.1: {victim} was bowled over by a barrel
overlay.feed.barrel.3: {victim} lost a fight with a barrel. A barrel.
overlay.feed.trap.1: {victim} found the spike trap the hard way
overlay.feed.trap.2: {victim} stepped on the glowing red thing. Of course.
control.title: Chroma Clash control panel
control.source.none: No channel yet: enter yours below.
control.running.nothing: Nothing is running on the overlay.
control.running.title: {title} is running on the overlay.
control.running.endless: Endless mode is running on the overlay.
control.error.connection: Lost the connection to the game. Retrying…
control.error.history: The history could not be loaded ({status}).
control.error.status: The status could not be loaded ({status}).
control.error.picture: That file could not be read as a picture.
control.error.size: Enter a number of chatters above 0.
control.dock.label: Quick controls
control.tabs.label: Sections of the control panel
control.guide.title: Getting started
control.guide.channelText: In the card below. The game reads its chat; nobody in chat has to do anything.
control.guide.obsText: Sources, +, Browser. Paste this address and set the size to 1920 × 1080:
control.guide.layerText: From then on chatters earn ticks, join guilds and develop the land.
control.guide.pictureText: The god wears it when you fight chat. Your Twitch profile picture works well; without one, the god wears your latest emote.
control.guide.testText: Check that it shows in OBS. It changes nothing in the game.
control.guide.done: All set. Start a War, a Guild Clash or a Pachinko round when chat is lively. The Status tab helps when something does not show up.
control.guide.waiting: Waiting for the overlay to connect…
control.channel.title: Twitch channel
control.channel.simulated: The chat simulator is running. Start the game without --sim to read your channel.
control.channel.none: Enter your Twitch channel name to start. The game reads its chat and remembers it for the next start.
control.channel.reading: Reading #{channel} ({status}). Each channel keeps its own game: switching opens that channel's seasons.
control.channel.confirmSwitch: Switch the game to #{channel}? The overlay shows that channel's game from then on.
control.layer.title: Background layer
control.layer.on: On since {time}. Chatters earn ticks and develop their guild's land.
control.layer.off: Off. Chat is read, but nobody earns anything and the overlay is empty.
control.map.title: Map and Monuments
control.map.label: Hex map of the territory
control.pace.played: Stream time this season: {played} of about {hours} hours.
control.pace.adapting: Until hour {until} the Monument goal (now {goal}) still adapts to your chat's pace; then it stays.
control.pace.forecast: At this pace {guild} finishes its Monument in about {remaining} more stream hours.
control.pace.soon: At this pace {guild} finishes its Monument in about an hour.
control.mishaps.title: Lightning, fire and harvests
control.mishaps.empty: Nothing yet this season. While the layer is on, lightning strikes tall tiles, fires burn until enough of the guild is active to put them out, and now and then a harvest raises a tile.
control.mishap.doused: The guild put out the fire on {where}: {change}
control.top.title: Most active this session
control.conquest.intro: Fights between the guilds that count: they move tiles, give rewards and shape the season.
control.war.text: Three battles, one per guild as attacker. A winning attacker takes the tile, which keeps half its development.
control.war.command: Let moderators and me start a War by typing !war in chat
control.clash.champion: Champion of this session: {name} ({guild}). The three most active chatters of each guild fight heats and a final.
control.clash.text: The three most active chatters of each guild fight heats and a final. The champion's guild earns +50% XP for 30 minutes.
control.guildClash.text: A countdown: everyone who writes in chat can be drawn, 10 per guild. The line-up is shown, then 3 per guild fight at a time and the others step in. The last guild standing wins the Hero Clash reward. Levels and land do not count.
control.god.title: God events
control.god.status: You fight as {name}. This season: {seasonWins} won, {seasonLosses} lost. All time: {lifetimeWins} won, {lifetimeLosses} lost. With {winsToWin} wins in a season you win the season yourself. God's Wrath attacks the guild whose Monument is furthest, for one tile. Streamer vs Chat is against all guilds at once: if you win, every guild loses a tile and part of its Monument.
control.god.versusUsed: Streamer vs Chat was already fought this session. For another round, start the friendly fight in the Arena tab.
control.god.versusNeedsLayer: Streamer vs Chat needs the background layer to be on.
control.god.versusOnce: Streamer vs Chat can be fought over the map once per session.
control.skills.title: Skills
control.skills.text: The god casts one of the enabled skills every few seconds. Its health adjusts to the skills, so the fight stays even.
control.picture.title: Picture
control.picture.has: The god wears this picture in battle.
control.picture.none: No picture yet: the god wears your latest emote. Upload your channel picture to use it instead.
control.arena.intro: Fights for fun. Nothing here changes the game: no tiles, no Monument, no XP.
control.free.text: A countdown: everyone who writes in chat can be drawn, 30 in all. The line-up is shown, then 10 fight at a time, everyone for themselves, and the others step in. The last one standing wins.
control.pachinko.text: A countdown, drawn like a Guild Clash: up to 10 chatters per guild. Each guild gets a board, every chatter drops down it once into a slot worth points, and the guild with the most points wins. A guild with fewer chatters drops some of them twice, so every guild drops as many balls.
control.friendly.title: Streamer vs Chat, friendly
control.friendly.text: You against all three guilds, as often as you like. Whoever wins, nothing changes.
control.friendly.tally: Friendly fights this season: {wins} won, {losses} lost.
control.friendly.apart: Friendly fights are counted apart from your score.
control.friendly.needsLayer: It needs the background layer to be on.
control.endless.on: On, with {count} fighters on screen. It changes nothing in the game; starting any other fight ends it.
control.endless.off: A never-ending free-for-all of your active chatters, for an intro, an outro or a break. Fallen fighters come back. It changes nothing in the game, and the map stays visible.
control.test.text: Shows a battle between guilds on the overlay, to see how it looks.
control.history.title: Seasons
control.history.noDetails: No details were recorded for this season.
control.history.ending.god: {name} reached the wins against chat that win a season
control.history.ending.streamer: ended by hand from this panel
control.language.note: The language of the overlay, this panel and the results in chat.
control.language.pinned: This page shows {language} because of ?lang= in its address. The choice here still sets the overlay and the chat.
control.address.title: Overlay address
control.address.text: Add this address in OBS as a browser source, 1920 × 1080:
control.address.empty: The overlay is empty while the background layer is off.
control.address.dock: The control panel also works as an OBS dock (Docks, Custom Browser Docks) with this address; in a narrow dock it shows only the main buttons:
control.actions.title: Stream Deck and hotkeys
control.actions.text: Each link does one thing, like pressing the button here. On a Stream Deck, add a Website action, paste the link and tick GET request in background. In OBS, the script tools/obs/chroma-clash-hotkeys.py turns the links into hotkeys (Tools, Scripts).
control.announce.title: Results in chat
control.announce.check: Write one line in chat when a War, a Clash, Pachinko, a god fight or a season ends
control.announce.available: Chat stays passive: nobody has to type anything. This only reports results, one line each.
control.announce.unavailable: Off: writing in chat needs a Twitch login. Start the game with TWITCH_LOGIN set to the account that should write (yours or a bot) and TWITCH_TOKEN to its token with the chat:read and chat:edit scopes.
control.banner.title: Map banner in battles
control.banner.text: During every battle a strip across the screen shows the map and each guild's land and Monument. The arena keeps clear of it: no fighter, skill or skill name ever covers it.
control.banner.label: Show it
control.obstacles.title: Obstacles
control.obstacles.text: Walls, pinball bumpers that fling fighters away, rolling barrels and spike traps. About two in five team battles get a layout of their own; in a free-for-all and the endless mode they appear and disappear.
control.look.title: Look
control.look.pixelateText: Only in themes that pixelate, such as Pixel RPG. Off keeps emotes sharp and easy to recognise.
control.look.animatedText: Moving emotes move in the fight. Off shows them still.
control.look.random: Random emote for chatters without one
control.look.randomText: A chatter who never used an emote fights as a random global emote, always the same one. Off: a plain circle.
control.look.namesText: Each fighter's name in battles. Off: emotes only, which keeps a crowded fight clean.
control.look.highlightsText: Noteworthy deaths beside the scoreboard, and who did it: first blood, ended streaks, the crown falling, lightning, traps and barrels.
control.look.sourcesText: Twitch emotes are always on. Chatters who use these emotes fight as them; a source switched off is neither recognised nor shown.
control.layout.title: Overlay layout
control.layout.text: Drag the two panels to where they should sit on the overlay. With a panel selected, the arrow keys move it in small steps. In endless mode the fighters keep off the panels.
control.tuning.title: Tuning
control.tuning.text: Changes apply at once and are kept between starts. An empty field restores the default.
control.tuning.advancedText: The game is tuned to run as it is. These are for tinkering; an empty field brings back the default.
control.size.title: Channel size
control.size.label: Active chatters per 5 minutes
control.size.notMeasured: Not measured yet; it needs a few minutes of chat with the background layer on.
control.size.cost: The cost to develop land is multiplied by {scale}.
control.excluded.title: Excluded users
control.excluded.text: Excluded users earn nothing and do not fight. Common bots are always excluded.
control.season.title: Season
control.season.confirm: Press again to end the season
control.season.equal: equal sectors: five tiles around each city
control.season.random: random land: the same tiles, dealt by lot
control.season.rules: A season ends by itself when a guild finishes its Monument. Ending it by hand names the guild whose Monument is furthest the winner. Either way the land is dealt again and Monuments, levels and guilds are reset; lifetime statistics are kept.
control.data.title: Saved game
control.data.text: Each channel's game is kept in a database file in the data folder.
control.data.backups: An import replaces this channel's game with the file's. Before an import or a reset, the current game is copied to data/backups, so it can be brought back.
control.data.resetLabel: To start this channel's game from nothing, type the channel name:
control.data.kept: The game of #{channel} is kept in a database file in the data folder. Export it to keep a copy or to move it to another computer.
control.data.none: There is no saved game yet: connect your channel first.
control.data.confirmImport: Replace the game of #{channel} with "{file}"? The current game is copied to data/backups first.
control.runtime: Takes about {time} min, start to finish
control.status.intro: For when something does not show up. Updated every few seconds while this tab is open.
control.status.noOverlay: No overlay is open. Add the overlay address to OBS as a browser source, or open it in a browser tab to try.
control.status.frameNote: A frame should take well under 16 ms. Frames per second drop to near zero while nothing moves; that is normal.
control.gpu.notice: The overlay draws without the graphics card, so battles will stutter. In OBS: Settings → Advanced → Sources → Enable Browser Source Hardware Acceleration, then restart OBS. In a browser: switch on hardware acceleration in its settings.
control.status.emoteNote: A channel without an account at a source has no channel emotes there; that is fine.
control.status.serverPauseValue: {ms} ms in the last minute (over 50 ms shows as a stutter)
control.status.inMemory: in memory until a channel is entered
